Grant resources automatically
Use Envoy's webhooks to automatically provision resources like wifi credentials, building access, or access to other apps and services when employees or visitors sign in. Then revoke access when they leave.
Do more with IoT and sensors
Use sensors, IoT devices, and Envoy APIs to book or free up unused spaces. Connect other hardware like cameras, thermal imaging, and voice assistants to add automation throughout your workplace.
Verify identity and secure the workplace
Approve or deny visitor entry in real-time using Envoy's synchronous webhooks. Capture identity data during sign-in and connect to external hardware like facial recognition devices to automatically verify if a visitor is welcome. Learn more about security.
Access real-time workplace data
Use Envoy APIs and webhooks to synchronize, display, and create interactive apps leveraging data from employee and visitor sign-ins, desk and room usage, maps, and more.
